messages.en:
{07 14 00}That was fun, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
Thanks to you, {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 05 00}
I totally enjoyed fishing!
{07 00 00}And on top of that,{01 00 00 05 00}{07 06 00} I now
know that I can never beat
you...{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 00 00}{07 14 00}But I'm cool with it!
{07 00 00}{07 0d 00}Instead of being a master
fisherman,{01 00 00 05 00} I'll just work
on my singing career!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}See oli lõbus, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

et ma ei suuda sind
iial võita...{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 00 00}{07 14 00}Aga pole viga!
{07 00 00}{07 0d 00}Kalapüügimeistri asemel{01 00 00 05 00}
